comments.author: @worldlifejourneyytb
comments.text: Bali's beauty is obvious, but the rice terraces and irrigation system tell a deeper story. The way communities work together through Subak shows how cooperation has shaped Balinese life for generations.

replies.author: @HappyTravel99
replies.text: Absolutely. The Subak system is one of the most fascinating parts of Balinese culture because it shows that the rice terraces are not only beautiful landscapes, but also the result of generations of cooperation, tradition, and respect for nature. Thank you for noticing this deeper side of Bali and for sharing such a thoughtful comment. We’re very glad you enjoyed the video! ❤️🙏
